name: Understory
line: Forest bathing in deep green and fog: a full-bleed misty beech wood carries the headline in pale Instrument Serif while three soft fog banks drift across it at different parallax depths, the two explorers stand as tall deep-green and moss panels with their networks drawn in pale lines like mycelium, and a fog-bound laurel forest sits still behind the page as a fixed band.
notes: The fog banks are layered radial gradients that drift sideways on slow CSS loops (62–110 s) inside wrappers with data-parallax 0.04, 0.10 and 0.22; with reduced motion they stay put. The hero text sits on a deep gradient over the forest floor so the pale type passes AA; the header is a solid fog bar because the top of the photograph mixes bright mist and dark trunks. The fixed band uses a clip-path frame around a position:fixed image, which works without JavaScript. Instrument Serif and Instrument Sans have no Cyrillic.
